semiconductor_relevance: Medium — MIRAPRO provides critical vacuum technology and components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: MIRAPRO specializes in providing vacuum technology and components, such as vacuum piping and high-purity gas piping, which are essential for maintaining the necessary environmental conditions in semiconductor fabrication. They also offer advanced products like welded and formed bellows, flexible hoses, and high-precision chillers, supporting the infrastructure needs of semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
